quest.example.power.electric_mechanism.t: Requires [[quest:example:power/wires]] and [[quest:example:power/dynamo]]. Hand in copper plates, keep 3 [[item:minecraft:redstone_block]].
guide.example.furnace.title: Furnace
guide.example.furnace.fuel.title: Fuel
guide.example.furnace.fuel.text:
[[item:minecraft:furnace]] smelts ore, but it needs fuel. [[item:minecraft:coal]] works best.

**Tip:** place the furnace next to a chest. Your quest: [[quest:example:start/first_furnace]].
guide.example.furnace.build.title: How to build
guide.example.furnace.build.text:
A furnace takes eight cobblestone:
[[recipe:minecraft:furnace]]
[[image:example:textures/guides/furnace.png|A furnace next to a chest]]
Then see [[guide:example:furnace#next|what to smelt next]].
guide.example.furnace.next.title: What next
guide.example.furnace.next.text: Once you have plenty of iron, build a [[item:minecraft:blast_furnace]]: it smelts twice as fast.
